movelist.name: Icy Wind
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Speed lowered 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Weather Ball
movelist.effect: If it is Sunny, Weather Ball is Fire-Type. If it is Rainy, Weather Ball is Water-Type. If it is Hailing, Weather Ball is Ice-Type. If it is Sandstorming, Weather Ball is Rock-Type. When a weather effect is on the field, Weather Ball has a Damage Base of 10 (3d8+10 / 24). If there are multiple Weather Effects on the field, choose one type for Weather Ball to be that corresponds with an existing Weather Effect.

movelist.name: Mist
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Mist may activate it when having Combat Stages lowered by any effect; if they do, those Combat Stages are instead not lowered. Mist may be activated 3 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Powder Snow
movelist.effect: Powder Snow Freezes all Legal Targets on 19+.

abilities.name: Ice Face
abilities.effect: Connection – Aromatic Mist. All allies affected by Aromatic Mist gain +1 to Accuracy Rolls and +5 to Damage Rolls for one full round.

abilities.name: Dry Skin
abilities.effect: Whenever the user is hit by a damaging Fire- Type Move or ends their turn in Sunny Weather, they lose a Tick of Hit Points. The user is immune to the damage and effects of Water-Type Moves, and whenever the user is hit by a damaging Water-Type Move or ends their turn in Rainy Weather, they gain a Tick of Hit Points.
